label: gbs5-ctl-unsat
rule: a qualified decision iff the receipt's verdict is the qualifying verdict, the receipt is durable, no driver signal was latched at the pre-evaluation check, after evaluation or at the decision in publish_qualification(), no SIGTERM/SIGINT was pending there, and the driver was the only thread; a decision record only: admission (qualification_problems) also needs the bound completion record, no cancellation, a clean durable run summary and the parent release attestation of this run (RELEASE_RULE)
meaning: decision record only; admission also needs the bound completion record, no cancellation and a clean durable run summary
